title: A Scaled-Up Empirical Study of Syntactic Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.16837v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Syntactic language models (SLMs) that generate sentences along with their syntactic tree structures have shown promise in both syntactic generalization and downstream tasks. Prior studies, however, have mostly evaluated smaller models trained on less pretraining data and tested on narrower task suites. In addition, the design space of tree linearization and attention masks remains underexplored. We conduct a large-scale empirical study of 12 controlled configurations---one terminal baseline and 11 SLM variants spanning different linearizations and masks---at scales up to 1B parameters and 100B training tokens, evaluated across 11 downstream tasks and two syntactic benchmarks. The experimental results show that SLMs with standard causal attention match or exceed structural-mask variants across downstream and syntactic benchmarks. translated_title: 句法语言模型的规模化实证研究
translated_abstract: 句法语言模型（SLMs）能够同时生成句子及其句法树结构，在句法泛化和下游任务中都展现出良好的前景。然而，先前的研究大多评估的是在较少预训练数据上训练的较小模型，且测试的任务范围较窄。此外，树线性化与注意力掩码的设计空间仍未得到充分探索。我们对12种受控配置进行了一项大规模实证研究——包括一个终端基线和11个涵盖不同线性化方式与掩码的SLM变体——模型规模最高达10亿参数、训练数据达1000亿词元，并在11个下游任务和两个句法基准上进行了评估。实验结果表明，采用标准因果注意力的SLM在下游任务和句法基准上的表现与结构掩码变体相当甚至更优。这类模型无需修改架构，且与FlashAttention保持兼容。我们还观察到……
tldr: 该论文通过大规模实证研究发现，使用标准因果注意力的句法语言模型在下游任务和句法基准上的表现与结构掩码变体相当甚至更优，且无需架构修改、与FlashAttention兼容。
en_tdlr: A large-scale empirical study shows that syntactic language models with standard causal attention match or exceed structural-mask variants across downstream and syntactic benchmarks, requiring no architectural modifications and remaining compatible with FlashAttention.
